title: /architecture
intro: discover the core components of our ecosystem and how they work together to power innovative AI applications and semantic software.

modules.name: rig framework
modules.summary: the foundational rust-based system for building and orchestrating powerful, lightweight AI agents. it provides core libraries, multi-agent support, and on-chain integrations.

children.name: core library
children.summary: essential utilities to create AI agents, manage prompts, handle embeddings, and maintain robust performance.

children.name: multi-agent & extensibility
children.summary: supports orchestrating multiple agents, embracing wasm for edge deployment, integrating with blockchains, and storing context in vector databases.

children.name: real-world projects
children.summary: demonstrates how multi-agent architectures are applied to real use cases, from data pipelines to on-chain governance.

children.name: wasm & edge deployments
children.summary: enables AI agent deployment on edge devices for low latency and minimal resource overhead.

children.name: on-chain integrations
children.summary: connects agents to solana, arbitrum, or other networks for reading on-chain data and executing smart contracts.

children.name: AI memory & vector stores
children.summary: provides intelligent memory systems for advanced AI features and continuous context retention.

modules.name: arc complex
modules.summary: a cyborg collective where developers and AI agents collaborate to build and enhance rig, sharing insights, culture, and technical advances.

children.name: ryzome
children.summary: your second brain, now with intelligence. an infinite canvas where knowledge comes alive with AI that understands context and connections.

key_advantages.name: context-aware AI
key_advantages.summary: connect nodes to build context chains so AI understands the full thought process, not just isolated prompts.

key_advantages.name: instant knowledge graphs
key_advantages.summary: research evolves into living knowledge graphs — connections, patterns, and insights surface automatically.

key_advantages.name: markdown-enabled nodes
key_advantages.summary: rich notes with full markdown support: format text, add images, organize thoughts.

key_advantages.name: visual thinking
key_advantages.summary: one canvas with infinite possibilities; draw connections between related ideas.

children.name: handshake program
children.summary: an open call inviting devs, dreamers, and innovators to propose and build with rig — requires a small arc deposit to prevent spam.

children.name: arc forge
children.summary: a streamlined token launch platform built atop meteora's dlmm and integrated with jupiter routing, routing liquidity flows through the arc token.

key_advantages.name: deeper, more efficient liquidity
key_advantages.summary: dlmm price bins enable high capital efficiency with minimal slippage in active bins.

key_advantages.name: arc-centric routing
key_advantages.summary: all trades flow through arc, capturing fees in arc and lowering circulating supply over time.

key_advantages.name: sniper prevention & liquidity control
key_advantages.summary: configurable bonding curve imposes steeper price impacts on first-block snipers.

key_advantages.name: expanded reach via jupiter & trading bots
key_advantages.summary: instant recognition by jupiter routing; tradable through bonkbot, trojan, photon, bullx from day one.

key_advantages.name: selective launch partners (initially)
key_advantages.summary: only vetted, high-quality handshake projects featured at first — quality over quantity.

key_advantages.name: customizable liquidity strategies
key_advantages.summary: multiple dlmm shapes — spot, curve, bid-ask — to manage liquidity across price ranges.
